children.game_version: The Spinning Top game: pairs hold hands and practice two slow turning steps, freezing on beat 4.

avoid: Sudden pivot twists that torque the knees
seniors.seated_version: Perform alternating foot taps to the 4/4 beat while gently rotating the upper torso in time with partner hands.
seniors.standing_version: Execute gentle weight shifts from foot to foot on beats 1 through 4, omitting full rotations or taking slow quarter-turns.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Moderate tempo with small, controlled steps within a narrow base of support.

feedback_rules.description: Maintain duple-meter 4/4 timing during partner rotation rather than shifting into triple meter.

learning_units.description: Mastering the duple-meter pivot-spin step in coordination with a partner.

prerequisites.description: Ability to execute continuous pivot turns without loss of balance.

social_formats.description: Couple dance involving rotating pivot turns.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couple dance travelling or rotating within a social dance space.
movement_profile.partnering: Couple partnering executing a shared pivot-spin.

signature_moves.description: A simple rotational step executed by the couple in 4/4 time to turn or rotate smoothly.
signature_moves.name: Pivot-spin step

music_profile.sound_description: A duple-meter 4/4 musical accompaniment that provides an even, rotating pulse for social couple dancing.

basic_steps: Step into partner hold in duple meter (4/4 time)
Execute a simple pivot-spin step while turning continuously with a partner
teaching.level_notes: A beginner starts by establishing steady weight shifts on each beat of the 4/4 meter before coordinating the pivot-spin rotation with a partner.
